notes.title: Welcome travelers!
notes.notes:
[i][h1]Please take a seat and learn about Homer's Odyssey, the upcoming interactive adventure inspired by the renowned classic Greek poem.[/h1][/i]
Get ready to [u][b]be the main protagonist of the story of Odysseus[/b][/u], also known as Ulysses, and relive his epic journey in the Mediterranean Sea. 

[h1][i]Will you be able to defeat your enemies and reclaim your throne?[/i][/h1]
[u][b]Add it to your wishlist[/b][/u] to stay up to date about all the upcoming news!
